negative_findings.description: No single consolidated, machine-readable NBS 'reporting submission calendar' page was located. Deadlines appear to be distributed across individual opatrenia (legal measures) as per-return tables (periodicity + deadline expressed as 'do 10. pracovného dňa', 'posledný kalendárny deň tretieho mesiaca', etc.) rather than as a published calendar file.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk queries for 'kalendár termínov predkladania výkazov' returned only the SDDS Plus advance PUBLICATION calendar and event calendars, not a submission calendar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline extraction for this cell must be built by parsing legal-measure annex tables, not by scraping a calendar; collection design should budget for PDF table parsing.

negative_findings.description: I did not find an NBS-hosted page publishing national FINREP/COREP XBRL taxonomy packages or DPM artefacts; SK banks appear to consume EBA-published taxonomies directly, with NBS publishing only methodological reconciliation documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk+en queries combining NBS with FINREP/COREP/taxonómia surfaced EBA pages and NBS 'Metodické informácie' but no NBS taxonomy repository.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Taxonomy-change tracking for SK banks should be anchored on EBA release cycles, with NBS pages watched only for national go-live/derogation notices.

negative_findings.description: The Štatistický zberový portál (ŠZP) and zber.statistics.sk submission areas require registered reporting-entity credentials; return catalogues and validation rule sets may live behind that login.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only public landing/registration pages were reachable in open search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some of the densest deadline/taxonomy artefacts may be unreachable to open collection; plan to rely on the legal measures plus any public technical annexes instead.

negative_findings.description: Several NBS document URLs are opaque GUID-based download endpoints (nbs.sk/dokument/<uuid>/stiahnut) that were not fetched in this pass; their liveness is unverified here.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded from search result listings only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as stable anchors; GUID endpoints may rotate on site republish.

coverage_gaps.description: Resolution-authority reporting (Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií / NBS resolution function: SRB liability data templates, MREL reporting, ex-ante contribution data submissions) was not covered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep on 'riešenie krízových situácií', 'MREL vykazovanie', 'príspevky do fondu riešenia krízových situácií' and SRB reporting calendars.

coverage_gaps.description: AML/CFT reporting to Finančná spravodajská jednotka (FSJ, NAKA) and PSD2 fraud reporting operational detail were not enumerated, though fraud data is referenced in the PI licensing condition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sweep FSJ/minv.sk reporting obligations and EBA fraud-reporting guidelines as applied in SK.

coverage_gaps.description: AnaCredit (Register bankových úverov a záruk) and the forthcoming Integrated Reporting Framework (IReF) national implementation timeline for SK were not researched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted queries on 'register bankových úverov a záruk RBUZ', 'AnaCredit Slovensko vykazovanie', 'IReF harmonogram'.

coverage_gaps.description: Slov-Lex (the official SK legal information system with machine-readable ELI/API access) was not directly profiled as the canonical carrier of Act 483/2001 (banks), Act 492/2009 (payment services) and Act 540/2001 (state statistics) reporting mandates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Profile slov-lex.sk API/ELI endpoints as a structured primary-law source for reporting obligations.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulatory-reporting vendors serving Slovak banks/PSPs (which reveal obligation changes early through release notes and webinars) were not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sweep vendor release notes and SK-market regtech providers as indirect early-warning sources.

brief: Slovak reporting and data-submission obligations are concentrated at Národná banka Slovenska, but the hard dates do not live in a calendar file — they live in per-sector 'opatrenia' published in the Vestník NBS (e.g. 8/2021 for banks' statistical returns with a 10th-working-day monthly pattern; 7/2023 for payment institutions, EMIs, limited-scope PSPs and banks with semi-annual/quarterly/monthly Ps(NBS) and Pb(NBS) returns), whose annexes tabulate return code, periodicity and deadline. Operationally, submissions flow through the Štatistický zberový portál (ŠZP, live since 2016, superseding STATUS-DFT), with methodology and code lists published openly under 'Informácie pre vykazujúce subjekty'; the publication side is dated in advance via the NBS data release calendar and the IMF SDDS Plus predstihový kalendár. Prudential taxonomies (FINREP/COREP DPM/XBRL) are consumed from the EBA upstream rather than republished nationally, while payments statistics taxonomy derives from ECB Regulation 2020/2011 (ECB/2020/59); the Štatistický úrad SR adds a parallel, legally distinct stream via the Program štátnych štatistických zisťovaní and zber.statistics.sk. Collection should therefore be built around legal-measure PDF table parsing plus EBA/ECB release monitoring, not around scraping a non-existent consolidated submission calendar.
